# 山行接駁（gohike.tw）

> 山行接駁是台北、台中出發的登山接駁包車服務，接送玉山、雪山・武陵四秀、合歡山群峰、大霸尖山、南湖大山、奇萊南華、嘉明湖、松蘿湖、羅馬縱走、高島縱走、塔曼山、北得拉曼、郡大山、霞喀羅古道等登山口，提供五人座（最多 4 位乘客）與九人座（最多 8 位乘客）兩種車型，整車計價。詢價請用 LINE（ID 0910321666）、WhatsApp、Email（taipei.cars@gmail.com）或網站上的詢價表單。

## 服務內容

- 登山接駁包車：從台北車站、台中高鐵站或指定地址出發，專車直達登山口；下山時在登山口接回市區。
- 行程：當日來回、兩天、三天以上都可以預約。
- 車型：五人座（最多 4 位乘客）、九人座（Volkswagen Caravelle 或同級，最多 8 位乘客）。
- 計價：整車計價，不是按人頭。單程是一趟車；來回是去程、回程各一趟；一天來回是當天送上山、等下山再載回。
- 入園入山申請、山屋、保險與裝備由乘客自行準備；詢價時可提供入山證、山屋的申請資訊。
- 付款：訂金可用匯款、LINE Pay，海外旅客可用 PayPal；尾款以新台幣現金或匯款支付。
- 取消：出發三日前可全額退費取消或改期；遇封山或官方管制，可於出發前一日取消。
- 詢價請用 LINE、WhatsApp（+886910321666）、Email 或網站表單（司機行車中不便接聽電話）。

## In English

Go Hike (山行接駁, gohike.tw) is a private hiking shuttle (trailhead transfer) in Taiwan, from Taipei and Taichung to mountain trailheads including Yushan / Jade Mountain (玉山), Xueshan / Snow Mountain & Wuling Four Peaks (雪山・武陵四秀), Hehuanshan peaks (合歡山), Dabajian (大霸尖山), Nanhu Mountain (南湖大山), Qilai South Peak & Nanhua (奇萊南華), Jiaming Lake (嘉明湖), Songluo Lake (松蘿湖). Priced per vehicle, not per person: 5-seat car (up to 4 passengers) or 9-seat van (up to 8 passengers), one way from NT$5,000. Overseas hikers can pay the deposit by PayPal. Book by WhatsApp (+886910321666), LINE (ID 0910321666) or email (taipei.cars@gmail.com). English page: https://gohike.tw/en/

English route pages (trailhead, drive time, prices, FAQ):
- [Yushan / Jade Mountain (玉山) hiking shuttle: Taiwan's highest peak, 3,952 m](https://gohike.tw/en/routes/yushan/)
- [Xueshan / Snow Mountain & Wuling Four Peaks (雪山・武陵四秀) hiking shuttle: Glacial cirques and the Black Forest, 3,886 m](https://gohike.tw/en/routes/xueshan/)
- [Hehuanshan peaks (合歡山) hiking shuttle: Alpine grassland, sea of clouds, easy 3,000 m summits](https://gohike.tw/en/routes/hehuan/)
- [Dabajian (大霸尖山) hiking shuttle: Taiwan's most recognizable barrel-shaped peak](https://gohike.tw/en/routes/dabajian/)

- [Qilai South Peak & Nanhua (奇萊南華) hiking shuttle: Open grassy ridges, 3,358 m](https://gohike.tw/en/routes/qilai/)

- [Songluo Lake (松蘿湖) hiking shuttle: A misty lake deep in the forest](https://gohike.tw/en/routes/songluo/)

- [Luoma traverse (羅馬縱走) hiking shuttle: A forest and ridge traverse](https://gohike.tw/en/routes/luoma/)
- [Gaodao traverse (高島縱走) hiking shuttle: Cedar forest and mid-elevation ridges](https://gohike.tw/en/routes/gaodao/)
